scope: Continuous characters and direct abelian quotients of the connected split group Spin_0(7,7); not a classification of U(1) subgroups inside a selected stabilizer or maximal compact reduction.

perfectness_control.lie_algebra: g=so(7,7), a real split simple Lie algebra of dimension 91
perfectness_control.cartan_counts: 42 same-sign rotation generators plus 49 opposite-sign boost generators
perfectness_control.rotation_witness: each same-sign E_ij-E_ji is, up to sign, [E_ia+E_ai,E_ja+E_aj] with an index a of opposite metric sign
perfectness_control.boost_witness: each opposite-sign E_ia+E_ai is, up to sign, [E_ij-E_ji,E_ja+E_aj] for j distinct from i
perfectness_control.conclusion: every basis generator is a commutator, so [g,g]=g

character_theorem.differential: d chi:g->iR is a Lie-algebra homomorphism into an abelian algebra
character_theorem.connectedness_effect: a continuous character with zero differential on connected G is identically one
character_theorem.direct_quotient_effect: G has no nontrivial connected abelian quotient and no direct full-group U(1) charge character

claim_ceiling: The connected split-D7 group cannot supply K1346's uniform U(1) charge by a full-group character or direct abelian quotient. This does not exclude a U(1) subgroup inside a separately selected stabilizer or compact reduction, and it does not identify any such subgroup with the source's physical hypercharge.
